    {"id": "TC2", "title": "Test password length just below 8 characters", "type": "negative", "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page", "steps": ["Enter a password with 7 characters"], "expected_result": "Password updated", "covers": ["AC1"]},
    {"id": "TC3", "title": "Test password length just above 64 characters", "type": "negative", "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page", "steps": ["Enter a password with 65 characters"], "expected_result": "Password updated", "covers": ["AC1"]},
    {"id": "TC4", "title": "Test password length boundary value 8 characters", "type": "boundary", "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page", "steps": ["Enter a password with 8 characters"], "expected_result": "Password updated", "covers": ["AC1"]},
    {"id": "TC5", "title": "Test password length boundary value 64 characters", "type": "boundary", "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page", "steps": ["Enter a password with 64 characters"], "expected_result": "Password updated", "covers": ["AC1"]},

    {"id": "TC7", "title": "Test password contains at least one lowercase letter", "type": "positive", "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page", "steps": ["Enter a password with at least one lowercase letter"], "expected_result": "Password updated", "covers": ["AC2"]},

    {"id": "TC9", "title": "Test password contains at least one special character", "type": "positive", "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page", "steps": ["Enter a password with at least one special character"], "expected_result": "Password updated", "covers": ["AC2"]},
    {"id": "TC10", "title": "Test password contains all four types of characters", "type": "positive", "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page", "steps": ["Enter a password with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one special character"], "expected_result": "Password updated", "covers": ["AC2"]},
